tree.name: rpk
tree.description: rpk is the Redpanda CLI and toolbox for managing Redpanda clusters, topics, consumer groups, and streaming pipelines.

global_flags.name: config

commands.name: topic
commands.description: Manage Kafka topics, including creating, deleting, and configuring topics. Also includes commands for producing and consuming messages.

seeAlso.content: xref:reference:rpk/rpk-topic/rpk-topic-describe-storage.adoc[Describe the storage status of a topic]

commands.name: create
commands.description:
Create one or more Kafka topics with configurable partitions, replication factor, and topic-level settings.

All topics created with one invocation have the same number of partitions, replication factor, and key/value configs. For example, `rpk topic create -c cleanup.policy=compact -r 3 -p 20 foo bar` creates two topics, `foo` and `bar`, each with 20 partitions, 3 replicas, and the `cleanup.policy=compact` config option set.

flags.name: dry
flags.description: Validate the topic creation request without actually creating the topic. Useful for testing configuration.

flags.name: if-not-exists
flags.description: Only create the topic if it does not already exist

flags.name: partitions
flags.description: Number of partitions for the topic. The default of `-1` uses the cluster's `default_topic_partitions` property. More partitions enable higher parallelism but increase resource usage.

flags.name: replicas
flags.description: Replication factor (must be odd); -1 defaults to the cluster's default_topic_replications

flags.name: topic-config
flags.description: Topic configuration properties in the format `key=value`. Can be specified multiple times. Example: `--topic-config retention.ms=86400000`.
